resources.string: Calen-Time shows today\'s meetings on your watch face. It reads your calendar on the watch only; nothing leaves the watch.
Calendar access is off, so the face can\'t show your meetings. Tap here to turn it on.
Calen-Time is on your watch. Touch and hold the watch face, then pick Calen-Time.
